description: Check the stored audit-event hash chain for a known FreeSign envelope ID. FreeSign recomputes event hashes, links, and sequence continuity, and cross-checks a signer-attested head when its signature verifies. Returns the integrity verdict and per-event check results. Chain integrity alone does not establish legal validity or inspect PDF content.
name: verify_audit_chain

attested_audit_chain_head_hash.description: The audit-chain head recorded in the v2 final payload, or null when unavailable. The head is used for the cross-check only when the final-payload signature verifies.

attested_head_signature_verified.description: True when the final-payload signature carrying the attested head was re-verified against the signer's on-file public key. False when not finalized or the signature did not verify.

broken_at.description: seq of the first broken event, or null (also null for a head_mismatch — no single event is at fault).

head_checked.description: True when an attested head was supplied and cross-checked against the recomputed chain.

head_match.description: Result of the head cross-check, or null when no attested head was available.

events.description: Always empty. Use chain.events for per-event check results.

title: Verify audit chain
